title: From Evaluation to Evolution: Benchmarking Image Editing and Evolving Image Models
title_zh: 从评估到进化：图像编辑基准测试与图像模型进化

paragraphs.en: 发布WeGenEditBench图像编辑基准与WeGenEvoStudio多智能体进化框架，实现图像模型针对性显著提升。 Real-world image editing requires coordinating multiple visual transformations with content preservation and reference constraints, yet aggregate scores can readily obscure unmet local requirements. Effective evaluation must therefore identify local failures and translate them into priorities for subsequent model improvement. We introduce WeGenEditBench, comprising 2,740 evaluation instances and 148 task types across single-image, text-intensive, and multi-reference editing. Pre-generated checklists shared across models decompose each request into atomic requirements; item-level deductions and visual evidence are established first and then summarized into scores for edit execution, preservation, visual quality, and task-specific correctness. To support the experience-acquisition component of recursive self-improvement (RSI), we develop WeGenEvoStudio, a unified multi-agent harness for RSI-oriented learning that integrates model-conditioned failure diagnosis, retrieval-grounded data construction, supervised adaptation, and re-evaluation. Among 15 evaluated configurations, GPT-Image-2 leads single-image editing with an Overall score of 4.076, while Seedream-5.0-Pro leads text-intensive editing at 4.291. Evolution experiments across four generation and editing benchmarks demonstrate substantial targeted gains: on their report-selected Top-5 single-image targets, FLUX.2 [dev] improves Overall from 1.083 to 3.517, while Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 gains 13.2%. Together, our benchmark and harness provide a foundation for developing more reliable image models through interpretable evaluation and feedback-driven learning.
paragraphs.zh: 发布WeGenEditBench图像编辑基准与WeGenEvoStudio多智能体进化框架，实现图像模型针对性显著提升。真实世界的图像编辑需要在保持内容并满足参考约束的前提下协调多种视觉变换，然而聚合分数很容易掩盖未满足的局部需求。 因此，有效的评估必须识别局部失败，并将其转化为后续模型改进的优先事项。 我们提出WeGenEditBench，包含2,740个评估实例和148种任务类型，涵盖单图编辑、文本密集型编辑和多参考编辑。 跨模型共享的预生成检查清单将每个请求分解为原子需求；先确立条目级扣分与视觉证据，再汇总为编辑执行、内容保持、视觉质量和任务特定正确性四个维度的分数。 为支持递归自我改进（RSI）中的经验获取环节，我们开发了WeGenEvoStudio，这是一个面向RSI学习的统一多智能体框架，集成了基于具体模型的失败诊断、以检索为基础的数据构建、监督微调与重新评估。 在评估的15个配置中，GPT-Image-2以4.076的总分领跑单图编辑，Seedream-5.0-Pro以4.291领跑文本密集型编辑。 在四个生成与编辑基准上的进化实验展示了显著的针对性提升：在其报告选出的Top-5单图目标上，FLUX.2 [dev]的总分从1.083提升至3.517，Qwen-Image-Edit-2511则提升了13.2%。 总之，我们的基准与框架通过可解释的评估和反馈驱动的学习，为开发更可靠的图像模型奠定了基础。
